verdict.rationale: Composio's docs describe restricting a session to specific toolkits (composio-docs-3) and combining `mcp:true` with a direct-tools preset to serve an MCP URL with exactly the listed tools (composio-docs-5), directly enabling allowlist-style, per-tool/server access control for an agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of enforcement, granular per-user or role-based policy controls, and audit/logging of denied calls.
